trigger: UE needs to update its registration with the network due to mobility or periodic timer expiry.
causes: UE moves to a new registration area
UE supports S1 mode and has not disabled its EUTRA capability
UE supports SNSSAI time validity information
UE supports SNSSAI location validity information
UE initiates the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update due to case zg (disaster roaming)
expected_outcomes: UE's registration is updated with the network
AMF starts an implementation specific timer for onboarding services when the registration procedure is successfully completed
UE considers the previously received allowed NSSAI as valid
error_handling: If the UE is unable to store its 5GMM and 5GSM contexts, the UE triggers the deregistration procedure.
